title: Botge Configuration Schema
description: Emote sources are opt-in. Review docs/TERMS.md before enabling providers.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference used by the editor.

use7TVGlobalEmotes.description: Allow emotes from the global 7TV set. Disabled by default; review docs/TERMS.md before enabling.

use7TVPersonalEmotes.description: Enable the 7TV set selected in the server Activity settings.

use7TVAddedEmotes.description: Enable individually added 7TV emotes and direct 7TV emote references.

useBTTVEmotes.description: Enable BetterTTV global, channel, and shared emotes.

useFFZEmotes.description: Enable FrankerFaceZ global and channel emotes.

useTwitchEmotes.description: Enable Twitch global emotes. Requires Twitch API credentials.
